summary.text: David Livingston represents Arizona House District 28, lives in Peoria, and chairs the House Appropriations Committee; his legislative page lists his occupation as financial advisor.

paragraphs.text: According to that biography, he graduated from Arizona State University with a bachelor's degree in finance in 1988, built a financial consulting business with Ameriprise Financial, and sold the franchise in 2013.
According to the biography, he was first elected to the Arizona House in 2012 and re-elected in 2014, and in his second term was chosen by fellow Republicans as Majority Whip.
